key.name: work-minutes
key.description: Length of a focus session in minutes.

key.name: short-break-minutes
key.description: Length of a short break in minutes.

key.name: long-break-minutes
key.description: Length of a long break in minutes.

key.name: long-break-interval
key.description: Number of focus sessions before a long break.

key.name: auto-start-next
key.description: Automatically start the next phase when the current one ends.

key.name: sound-enabled
key.description: Play a sound when a phase ends.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Show a desktop notification when a phase ends.

key.name: close-to-tray
key.description: Hide the window instead of quitting when closed.

key.name: minimize-to-tray
key.description: Hide the window instead of minimizing when possible.

key.name: show-tray-icon
key.description: Keep a tray icon visible while Pomato is running.

key.name: goal-name
key.description: Custom name for the countdown goal (e.g. exam or deadline).

key.name: goal-date
key.description: Target date for the countdown in YYYY-MM-DD form.

key.name: fullscreen-bg-path
key.description: Image path used as the fullscreen background. Empty = native GTK background.

key.name: fullscreen-bg-dim
key.description: Dark mask opacity over the fullscreen background image (0 = clear, 1 = solid black).

key.name: fullscreen-bg-blur
key.description: Blur radius in pixels applied to the fullscreen background image.

key.name: fullscreen-bg-color
key.description: CSS color for the fullscreen mask (black, white, or any custom color).
